name: Driskill Graduate Program in Life Sciences (DGP)
summary: Life sciences doctoral training with first-year laboratory rotations and subsequent thesis laboratory selection.

english.note: MET minimum 61. Duolingo and TOEFL Essentials not accepted. English-instructed accredited degree may satisfy the requirement; scores valid for two years before matriculation. See Graduate School waiver rules. DGP's older 90-only wording predates the Graduate School's new-scale policy.

applicationFee.note: Graduate School waivers require U.S. citizenship or permanent residency and qualifying eligibility; limited and first come, first served. No additional program waivers.

documents: Resume/CV with education, research positions and hours/week, publications and presentations
Academic statement (1000 words): scientific journey (~250) and research statement (~750)
requirements.note: At least one recommendation should discuss scientific research performance. Letters should use institutional email. Specify Computational Biology and Bioinformatics Track in specialization if applying to that track.

funding.note: Full tuition and stipend for admitted domestic and international students who progress satisfactorily; health, dental and vision coverage. Rate is explicitly 2026–2027, not a confirmed Fall 2027 amount.

timeline.interviews: All 2027 admissions interviews virtual; admitted applicant visits in March and April.
